gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian reads modern and clean, with curves that stay open. Expose compresses its display letters into a striking, refined headline, while the body font keeps its curves open and modern.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic has big, glassy counters and round, parenthesis-like forms. Text runs on in a modern, professional hum, open and unhurried across many lines, while Expose stays tight and striking overhead.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Noto Sans Hebrew has a big midsection that fills out each line. Reading flows steadily through its wide curve gaps, and Expose adds a compressed, refined punch to the headline above.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Tight, striking Expose sits over Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, whose open eyes and deep middle band fill the line. Lines of text go down clean and unhurried, with no snags.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada feels approachable, with s curves that open wide. Next to it, Expose feels compressed and striking, and the two sit together like a quick shout and a friendly reply.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Khojki leaves its exits wide enough to pass light. And Expose, compressed and striking, gives each headline a tight, refined edge to push against.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Expose sets striking, refined letters in a compressed, hurried cadence. Noto Sans Lepcha brings generous curve openings and lowercase of cast-iron stature, so text moves along with approachable ease.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-limbu: A compressed cadence with barely any pause defines Expose, giving headlines a striking, refined squeeze. And Noto Sans Limbu lets its gaping curves and tall-bodied small letters keep the text friendly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Almost no pause between its letters gives Expose a striking, compressed cadence. Noto Sans Mandaic runs smoother, its lowercase rising near capital height and its curves loose, so paragraphs feel unclamped and professional.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-modi: Striking Expose squeezes its letters into a tight, hurried cadence. Noto Sans Modi takes over for reading, with daylight in every curve, so text moves along clean and modern.
